design_notes.role_ownership: Evaluator owns regression tests/helpers and red/mutant design; Generator repairs cleanup/help/role docs; independent Validator gates; Evaluator separately verifies actual candidate/CI.
design_notes.staging: Initial tests/source/scheduling may precede QA; final debt/A04a closure only after real capableCI/approvedQA/evidence gate. No command before QA requires future finalQA path.
design_notes.draft_condition: Final proposed contract based on actual merged PR1 0eb3bcf5e15f612b4c87f86ff8a2521a0e2d66f2. Both independent pre-code approvals remain required. No implementation authorization inferred.

capable_ci_exact_steps.namespace_prerequisite: Preserve existing guarded CI userns sysctl step; no workstation sysctl change; no allow-unsupported flag on any required step.
capable_ci_exact_steps.checkout_receipt: Add a narrow inline Python receipt step in both existing jobs: print git rev-parse HEAD as checkout_sha and SHA256 bytes for exactly the nine assessed paths before acceptance commands; retain actual job log/output for evaluator receipt. This proves executed code identity even under synthetic merge checkout.

design_notes.remote_execution_receipt: AT2/3 require actual candidate-bound capableCI run/job/step identity and fresh exact-command execution, not inferred old green logs or local unsupported pass. Evaluator may use GitHub rerun API on actual candidate job; provenance/actual exit stays explicit.
design_notes.closure_checker_stages: Required --stage intake explicitly asserts debt047/046/045 in Open table and absent Resolved, A04a pending; tests cannot require future QA. Required --stage final asserts all three exclusively Resolved and A04a complete, immutable source-candidate record/digests, actual CI receipt exact AT1-3 bindings, red base proof, QA approved true6/6 with empty blocking arrays and candidate_sha/evidence command equality, and durable evidence-gate EXIT0. No auto-stage/default/intake fallback. Final command capture is distinct 06-final-maintenance-closure.txt and not a member of pre-closeout QA checks, avoiding circular evidence.

schema.candidate_sha: full 40 lowercase hex, actual committed repaired-source CI head
schema.source_sha256: mapping of all assessed_source_paths to SHA256 of bytes from git show candidate_sha:path

fixed_candidate_protocol.binding: Capture once before final docs; checker rejects differing existing record, source path set mismatch, missing candidate git object, digest mismatch with pinned git tree or current assessed file. Final docs HEAD is never substituted.

ci_receipt_schema.checks: exact three records AT1/AT2/AT3 each command byte-equal declared command, exit_code0, conclusion success, candidate_sha equal fixed candidate, run_id/run_url matching actual run, job_id/job_url and step_name, started_at/completed_at, evidence path equal declared evidence and log_sha256 matching archived raw output; downloaded logs must show actual exact-command execution. Evaluator independently verifies GitHub API run headSHA and job/step execution; receipt cannot be inferred from log text alone. Each record additionally includes actual checkout_sha (full40 Git HEAD) and source_sha256 emitted in that executing job; all nine digests equal immutable candidate map.
ci_receipt_schema.checkout_binding: run.head_sha must equal captured source candidate. Actions default checkout may execute synthetic merge HEAD: each AT1/2/3 record must include actual checkout_sha plus source_sha256 for exactly nine assessed paths, emitted by an explicit receipt step within that same executing job. Digest map must equal candidate record; do not require checkout_sha == candidate_sha. Evaluator independently binds downloaded checkout receipt/output to actual run/job, commands and archive digests.

red_receipt_schema.ordering: Actual Evaluator capture before Generator repair. Missing object/setup2 is not red. If CI fallback, fetch exact base object in owned execution or use fetch-depth0 checkout; never weaken job to accept setup failure.

design_notes.executable_negative_mode: --self-test runs isolated in-memory/owned-temp mutations through the same closure predicates: candidate SHA disagreement; stale source digest; missing required CI check; mismatched CI head; command mismatch; missing/false QA; wrong QA candidate; missing evidence gate; one debt not resolved; A04a pending at final; final stage supplied intake artifacts. Each must fail specifically; setup errors cannot count as rejection. Intake self-test uses isolated candidate/proof fixtures only for checker controls, clearly marked synthetic and never acceptance proof. Final stage additionally mutates actual parsed captured proofs before validating unmutated final state.

proposal_predicates.purpose: Executable pure stage/pin/receipt/QA/red/evidence predicates and 13 synthetic negative controls; reviewed with proposal, incorporated into new task checker after gates. Runtime wrapper reads exact named real repository files, hashes Git tree/current source and actual archive bytes; no synthetic controls can become acceptance evidence.

design_notes.scope_semantics: Compare product paths and new task metadata only to actual PR1 merge base. Parent run_state may change only updated_at, active_contract_id, last_action, append-only task history and post-ga-maintenance-prefixed bounded counters (limit3/attempts0..3); all phase/budget/status fields and prior history/counters remain exact. Freeze all previously existing evidence, including post-ga-planning-refresh. No deletions/renames, no installed or sandbox source changes; tools/validate.sh content outside its --payload help paragraph byte-identical to base. Released CHANGELOG sections and HANDOVER historical snapshot byte-identical to base.
design_notes.source_commit_ordering: All CI acceptance commands and checkout/digest receipt emission are stateless with respect to source-candidate.json, CI receipt, QA and final closure. Parent first commits/pushes repaired source with intake docs; then captures that actual commit SHA outside repository and writes fixed source-candidate metadata later. Evaluator fresh actual CI execution/rerun stays at the same PR source head before evidence metadata commits. Subsequent docs/evidence commits may move HEAD; nine assessed source/test/workflow bytes must remain identical to fixed candidate. Never embed a commit own SHA in the same commit or require future candidate metadata in source CI.
